examples.title: A scroll story from the brief to the build
examples.task: Plan a new story about river restoration, decide how it moves while scrolling and build it in our project, which uses GSAP.

selections.reason: A new story needs its reader, angle, outline and voice first.
The request leaves the movement open, so it is specified before any code.
The project uses GSAP and the movement is to be implemented.

examples.reason: The brief, then the pacing, then the code. A path the AI chose for this request, not a rule for every story.
